task.title: Making your first request
task.shortdesc: List the adoptable dogs in your sandbox shelter, then fetch one of them.

prereq.p: You need a sandbox key with the animals:read scope, and curl or any HTTP client.

step.cmd: Store your key in an environment variable.

stepresult.p: The response contains a page of animals and a cursor for the next page:

result.p: You've authenticated and read data from the API. Next, learn how to page through large result sets, or subscribe to webhooks so you don't need to poll.
